objective: Local weather, severe storm through drizzle, and continuous morphing without wave/animation resets

localWeather.ui: Local weather · Open-Meteo and continuous storm slider verified; slider 40% preview action worked; returned to Follow Local Weather; rendering verified visually.

requirements.stage1: 45 m/s synthetic hurricane preset, dense rain/clouds/mist/whitecaps, scheduled lightning, 11.15 m rendered spectral-height proxy. Fixed camera preserved.
requirements.stage2: Five menu presets and continuous 0–1 slider; independent rain/cloud/wind/thunder inputs from regional current conditions.
requirements.stage3: Critically damped target changes preserve current value/velocity. Integrated cloud/detail advection, complex-spectrum relaxation with retained phases and foam history. GPU buildup/settling/onset, month-uptime wind turn, and bounded rain-clock continuity checks passed.

weatherGPUVerification.scope: Real GPU readback: finite waves, sky, reflections and display; storm/drizzle range and sea buildup/settling. Height proxy is 4*sqrt(sum cascade height variances), not a measured local sea-state forecast. Fixed camera, no windows/network/user-cache writes. Images require visual review.

modelTests:
LIGHTNING_FIXTURE: 5.715996918678283
PASS: hurricane→drizzle, bounded per-frame changes, interrupted transitions, frame-rate independence, shortest wind turn, validated weather units/age/status.
providerOfflineTests: PASS: request coalescing, 15-minute cache, restart recovery, failure retention/backoff, corrupt/expired-cache recovery, stale-location race rejection, HTTPS/unit policy; no real network in fixtures.
liveHTTPSContract: Actual Open-Meteo HTTPS reply for synthetic NYC coordinates decoded successfully; no user location included in this report.

regressions.scope: Prior final weather build passed these gates; subsequent changes affect only active-weather detail advection, rain direction/periodic curtains and matching baseline fog constants, all covered by the current 18 weather fixtures. Inactive weather branches retain existing behavior.

performance.scope: Sequential 180-frame runs, 60 warmup frames excluded, 1280x800/30fps on this Mac. Before/after are identical fixed-weather reference workloads. Hurricane/building are additional current-app workloads, not equivalent-image comparisons. No validation, profiling, other rendering tests or visible Ocean preview during timing. Command-buffer times, not battery/WindowServer/energy measurement.

resourceChanges.newPass: One bounded complex-spectrum relaxation while sea is changing; new target spectrum at most once per active second. No second FFT/ocean render loop.

limitations: Regional weather model at approximate IP location, not an exact-site sensor.
Idealized sea state derived from wind/rain severity, not a local marine forecast.
Procedural layered rain and approximate lightning/scattering; snow/hail/audio/storm surge are outside these rain/storm stages.
